scope: Actual cubic Hermite positive-score decomposition and nuclear reduction, plus quantitative common-scale outer entropy; H1 geometric and final summed propositions remain open

endpoints.name: RectangleCLTArxivV1.supplementalH_entropy_cardinality_budget
endpoints.expanded_type:
∀ {M B A L R m : ℝ},
  0 ≤ M →
    0 ≤ A →
      1 ≤ L →
        1 ≤ R →
          1 ≤ m →
            Real.log m ≤ L →
              ∀ (K : ℕ), M ≤ A * R → B ≤ A * m ^ K → M * Real.log (m ^ K) + B / m ^ K - M ≤ A * (↑K + 1) * L * R

endpoints.name: RectangleCLTArxivV1.supplementalH_integral_entropy_cardinality_bound
endpoints.expanded_type:
∀ {Ω : Type u_1} {ι : Type u_2} [inst : MeasurableSpace Ω] [inst_1 : Fintype ι] (μ : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω)
  (p b : ι → Ω → ℝ),
  (∀ (a : ι), Measurable (p a)) →
    (∀ (a : ι), Measurable (b a)) →
      (∀ (a : ι) (x : Ω), 0 ≤ p a x) →
        (∀ (a : ι) (x : Ω), p a x ≤ b a x) →
          (∀ (a : ι), MeasureTheory.Integrable (p a) μ) →
            (∀ (a : ι), MeasureTheory.Integrable (b a) μ) →
              ∀ {A L R m : ℝ},
                0 ≤ A →
                  1 ≤ L →
                    1 ≤ R →
                      1 ≤ m →
                        Real.log m ≤ L →
                          ∀ (K : ℕ),
                            ∫ (x : Ω), ∑ a, p a x ∂μ ≤ A * R →
                              ∫ (x : Ω), ∑ a, b a x ∂μ ≤ A * m ^ K →
                                ∫ (x : Ω), ∑ a, p a x * Real.log (b a x / p a x) ∂μ ≤ A * (↑K + 1) * L * R

endpoints.name: RectangleCLTArxivV1.supplementalH_cubic_selector_decomposition
endpoints.expanded_type:
∀ {p r K : ℕ} (s : RectangleCLT.FaceSmoother p) (A : Matrix (Fin p) (Fin r) ℝ) (v : RectangleCLT.Vector p)
  (α : Fin K → RectangleCLT.Face p),
  (∀ (i : Fin K), α i ∈ s.faces) →
    ∀ (u : RectangleCLT.Vector r),
      RectangleCLTArxivV1.supplementalHCubicSelectorScore s A v α u =
        ((RectangleCLT.Companion.weightedScore (RectangleCLT.standardGaussian r) id fun g =>
              RectangleCLTArxivV1.supplementalHPositiveDirection u g *
                RectangleCLT.Companion.selectorWeight s α (A.mulVec g + v)) -
            RectangleCLT.Companion.weightedScore (RectangleCLT.standardGaussian r) id fun g =>
              RectangleCLTArxivV1.supplementalHPositiveDirection (-u) g *
                RectangleCLT.Companion.selectorWeight s α (A.mulVec g + v)) -
          RectangleCLTArxivV1.supplementalHSelectorMass s A v α •
            (Matrix.vecMulVec u
                (RectangleCLT.Companion.weightMean (RectangleCLT.standardGaussian r) id fun g =>
                  RectangleCLT.Companion.selectorWeight s α (A.mulVec g + v)) +
              Matrix.vecMulVec
                (RectangleCLT.Companion.weightMean (RectangleCLT.standardGaussian r) id fun g =>
                  RectangleCLT.Companion.selectorWeight s α (A.mulVec g + v))
                u)

endpoints.name: RectangleCLTArxivV1.supplementalH_cubic_selector_nuclear_reduction
endpoints.expanded_type:
∀ {p r K : ℕ} (s : RectangleCLT.FaceSmoother p) (A : Matrix (Fin p) (Fin r) ℝ) (v : RectangleCLT.Vector p)
  (α : Fin K → RectangleCLT.Face p),
  (∀ (i : Fin K), α i ∈ s.faces) →
    ∀ (u : RectangleCLT.Vector r),
      RectangleCLT.vectorNormSq u = 1 →
        RectangleCLT.Companion.SplitV4.symmetricNuclearNorm
            (RectangleCLTArxivV1.supplementalHCubicSelectorScore s A v α u) ≤
          2 * RectangleCLTArxivV1.supplementalHCubicMeanEnergy s A v α u +
                2 * RectangleCLTArxivV1.supplementalHCubicMeanEnergy s A v α (-u) +
              RectangleCLTArxivV1.supplementalHSelectorMass s A v α *
                (1 +
                  RectangleCLT.vectorNormSq
                    (RectangleCLT.Companion.weightMean (RectangleCLT.standardGaussian r) id fun g =>
                      RectangleCLT.Companion.selectorWeight s α (A.mulVec g + v))) -
            ∫ (g : RectangleCLT.Vector r),
              (RectangleCLT.vectorNormSq g - ↑r) * |RectangleCLT.faceDot u g| *
                RectangleCLT.Companion.selectorWeight s α (A.mulVec g + v) ∂RectangleCLT.standardGaussian r
